summary: Iteration 73 — Backend-only verification of new booking flow (POST /api/sessions) and approval-modal verification-status endpoint. 13/13 pytest tests PASSED against https://highlight-vibe-bugs.preview.emergentagent.com. CRITICAL P0 BUG FOUND AND FIXED: /app/backend/routes/session_routes.py was missing imports for `MembershipStatus`, `REFERRAL_CREDIT_CENTS`, and `create_and_send_notification` — every POST /api/sessions call was 500-ing with NameError on line 91, which meant the entire booking flow added in this iteration (confirm-booking.tsx → POST /api/sessions) was completely broken on the deployed backend. After fixing imports, full flow now works: trainee POSTs /api/sessions with the trainer-detail.tsx payload shape ({traineeId, trainerId, sessionDateTimeStart ISO, durationMinutes:60, sessionType:'outdoor', locationType:'outdoor', locationNameOrAddress}) → 200 with status='requested' → new session appears in GET /api/trainee/sessions?session_status=requested and the pending count increments by 1. Also verified GET /api/trainer/verification-status returns required FE-contract shape {steps:{identity|background|certification|cpr|insurance|photo|video}, canGoLive:bool, missingRequirements, verificationStatus, ...}; admin approval flow via POST /api/admin/verifications/{trainer_id}/approve flips canGoLive→true. Regression sanity (login admin+trainee+trainer, /api/auth/me, /api/trainer-profiles/{id}, /api/trainee/sessions, /api/experiments/event, /api/instagram/data-deletion) all green.

critical.issue: FIXED — NameError: 'MembershipStatus' is not defined (also REFERRAL_CREDIT_CENTS and create_and_send_notification were unimported). Triggered 500 on every booking attempt. Added imports in /app/backend/routes/session_routes.py.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE — When the booking flow was implemented this iteration (confirm-booking.tsx now actually calls POST /api/sessions instead of being a no-op), the backend session_routes.py was updated with new logic at lines 87-93 (membership lookup) and 124-153 (referral activation + notification), but the corresponding imports were never added. Python only raises NameError at runtime, so the syntax-valid file passed startup checks but every POST /api/sessions blew up with 500. REPRODUCTION — POST /api/sessions with any valid payload → 500 + backend log: `NameError: name 'MembershipStatus' is not defined`. MITIGATION — Added `MembershipStatus, REFERRAL_CREDIT_CENTS` to the `from models import` block and `create_and_send_notification` to the `from deps import` block in /app/backend/routes/session_routes.py. Verified end-to-end booking flow now returns 200 and the session is queryable via /api/trainee/sessions?session_status=requested. RECOMMEND — Enable ruff (already in /app) on pre-commit and CI to block this class of bug.
